rationale: The concentrated limiter was unmeasured incremental value against free and incumbent filing routes, compounded by direct-filing cost and liability. The redesign makes a filing-neutral, reseller-embedded, outcome-measured release gate the entire wedge: no filing roadmap, no separate forwarder subscription, and no production scale before a paid pilot measures defects and channel economics. This materially changes payer, paid event, distribution, scope, and cost structure without asserting a partner, interface right, outcome, or economic result.
